title: Stochastic Transport and Wave Interactions for Multiscale Surface Gravity Waves: Part II: Kinetic Theory and Ocean-Wave Applications
summary: Building on the stochastic variational framework established in the companion paper, we investigate here the linearized stochastic water-wave system, consisting of a large-scale stochastic wave dynamics coupled to transport dynamics for the small-scale correlation modes. Within this framework, we develop, in the deep-water regime, a kinetic theory for surface gravity waves interacting with unresolved stochastic velocity fields.
